description: This file defines an abstract class 'GenericItem' implementing 'ItemInterface', with methods and properties related to item payloads, conflict resolution, and singleton behavior in a data model.

classes.name: GenericItem
classes.description: An abstract class representing a generic item with payload management, conflict resolution, and singleton logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the GenericItem with payload, sets properties, and freezes the object.

methods.name: uuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the payload.

methods.name: content_type
methods.description: Returns the content type of the payload.

methods.name: created_at
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the payload.

methods.name: serverUpdatedAtTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the server update timestamp as a number.

methods.name: dirty
methods.description: Returns whether the payload is dirty.

methods.name: lastSyncBegan
methods.description: Returns the last sync start time.

methods.name: lastSyncEnd
methods.description: Returns the last sync end time.

methods.name: duplicate_of
methods.description: Returns the duplicate reference of the payload.

methods.name: payloadRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a copy of the payload, optionally overridden.

methods.name: neverSynced
methods.description: Indicates if the item has never been synced to a server.

methods.name: isSingleton
methods.description: Indicates if the item is a singleton; default false.

methods.name: singletonPredicate
methods.description: Returns the predicate for singleton items; must be overridden.

methods.name: strategyWhenConflictingWithItem
methods.description: Determines conflict resolution strategy when conflicting with another item.

methods.name: satisfiesPredicate
methods.description: Checks if the item satisfies a given predicate.
